customManagers.description: Keep the pinned skills-ref revision fresh. The pin is a PEP 508 direct reference, which the pip_requirements manager skips, and the filename does not match its default pattern either — without this, the validator would silently drift behind the spec it enforces.
Keep the lychee release the Link Check workflow installs current. It is pinned as a release tag in an env var, which no manager enabled by config:recommended reads.
